I am an old woman here in Balaka, and my maize plot is very small — just a little piece by the house. I have no husband's help and no schooling, but I know maize needs fertilizer or the ears will be empty. If the chief's list has my name this year for the coupon, I will get one bag of NPK and one bag of urea — I will use it all on this small maize plot because it is what feeds us. I keep a few chickens and sometimes sweep the kraal for manure to put in the planting holes. I cannot afford to hire people, so I will do the weeding myself, maybe with help from my daughter when she comes.
